C. I. D
313
675/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

May 3rd 191 6.

Sir,
At 10 a.m. 2nd instant a Cantonese dressed in foreign clothes was arrested near the Shanghai Hangchow Railway Station on suspicion of being a rebel spy.
It is reported that General Lu of Woosung having received information that his gunners are disloyal has removed the breach blocks from some of the guns and has taken them to his headquarters.
Normal conditions prevail in Jusieh. The Nanking troops have left the Chi Ta hotel.
The Japanese whose arrest by the Arsenal Authorities was referred to in yesterday's report is named K.Hatakeyama. He was handed over on 1st instant to the Japanese Authorities who sent him to Japan on 2nd instant by the s.s. Yamashiro Maru. Hatakeyama came to Shanghai about a week ago. Since his arrival he has been staying in a Japanese lodging house at No.43 Seward Road. He had no employment. It is now reported that he had only one revolver in his possession when arrested, and that he was alone. The Japanese Consular Authorities say that Hatakeyama lost his way and wandered into Chinese territory.

Your Obedient Servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

刑事侦缉处
313
675/16

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科。）

1916年5月3日。

先生：

本月2日上午10时，一名身穿西式服装的广东男子在上海杭州火车站附近因涉嫌为叛军间谍而被捕。

据悉，吴淞的卢将军因获悉其炮手不忠，已卸下部分火炮的炮闩，并将其移至其司令部。

闸北局势正常。南京部队已撤离吉大旅馆。

昨日报告中提及的由兵工厂当局逮捕的日本人，姓名为K. Hatakeyama（音译）。他已于本月1日被移交给日本当局，后者于本月2日通过“山城丸”号轮船将其遣送回国。Hatakeyama约于一周前抵达上海。自抵沪以来，他一直居住在西华德路43号的一家日式寄宿寓所内。他并无职业。现据报告，他被捕时仅持有一支左轮手枪，且当时独自一人。日本领事当局称，Hatakeyama系迷路后误入华界。

您顺从的仆人，

总探长。

警务处总监。
